responsibility: This file is the D frontend’s bridge to GCC built-in types and functions. It initializes the builtin type table from GCC’s builtin definitions, registers target and common builtins for the D language, converts GCC tree types into equivalent D frontend `Type` objects for the synthetic `gcc.builtins` module, caches those conversions for reuse, and records builtin function/type declarations so they can later be exposed to D semantic analysis and compile-time reflection.
